title: Brackenridge Land & Airport Concession Policy
summary:
*   Received an update on ongoing negotiations regarding the significant Brackenridge Tract.
*   Reviewed current airport contracts, including a withdrawn proposal from Dobbs and existing parking agreements.
*   Discussed implementing a city-wide policy for airport concessions, prompting a call to scrutinize all city concessions during upcoming budget discussions.

Motion Made and Withdrawn
Councilmember Barnstone made a motion to adopt a City policy on all airport concessions as
